name: Sakkur
title: The Scout from the Tribe of Issachar
summary: Sakkur, son of Jiftak, was one of the twelve scouts whom Moses sent out to explore the land of Canaan. He represented the tribe of Issachar in this important mission. He was among the ten scouts who returned with a negative report and discouraged the Israelites from entering the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Sakkur was chosen by Moses to represent the tribe of Issachar in spying out the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Spying Mission in Canaan
keyEvents.description: Sakkur was part of the group of twelve men who explored the land of Canaan for forty days, from the Desert of Sin to Rehob.

keyEvents.title: The Negative Report
keyEvents.description: Sakkur was among the ten spies who brought back a discouraging report and claimed that the people in the land were too strong to be defeated.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion
keyEvents.description: The negative report from Sakkur and the other spies led the entire congregation of Israel to rebel against Moses and Aaron, wanting to return to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on the Unfaithful Spies
keyEvents.description: As punishment for their treacherous report and for causing the people to grumble against the Lord, Sakkur and the other nine negative spies died from a plague before the Lord.
